name: Shussan Sasecchau zo!
source:
Visual novel of erotic comedy. The main character impregnates the girl who lives on the next door and she gives the birth to the child.
Many situations are featured such as lost of virginity, sex during pregnancy and childbirth at home.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ047985.html]DLsite English[/url]]

色情喜剧视觉小说。主角让住在隔壁的女孩怀孕，并生下了孩子。
许多情况都具有特色，例如失去童贞、怀孕期间发生性行为以及在家分娩。
